scope: PNG image export for 2D, 3D Layout and Solid Model viewers

implemented.entry: Neutral camera button beside settings and refresh in all three viewers
implemented.format: PNG at current viewport size and live render scaling
content: Actual current scene/camera, pan/zoom, ray visibility, render mode and cutaway
Orientation indicators and visible scale bar
Complete material legend, independent of UI scrolling
Visible metadata with wrapping; preserve displayed stale-ray warning
implemented.snapshot: Render image and suggested filename synchronously before awaiting the save picker; file switches do not replace pending content
implemented.storage: BoundedApplicationFile.WriteAtomic using existing MaximumImageDataBytes; local file picker, PNG MIME/filter, overwrite prompt; cancel never writes
implemented.availability: Only export action disabled for no scene, refresh, outdated source revision, pending export or disposed viewer; localized tooltip and accessibility explanation; success/failure feedback is separate from optical metadata

tests.renderProcess: Independent headless Skia process with VIEWER_EXPORT/VIEWER_CONFIGURATION capture variables. Pixel cases follow existing opt-in image-test convention.
coverage: Six wide/narrow actual viewport exports, ray visibility, pan/zoom, opaque/transparent/cutaway modes
PNG encoding/decoding and real button saves for all three views
Invalid target reports failure without replacing scene metadata
Pending dialog snapshot survives a locked file switch
Empty, refreshing and locked outdated views cannot export; enabled state clears old reasons
Full synthetic 24-material legend extends below screen viewport; last swatch verified in encoded PNG
Localized tooltips and accessible names in Chinese, English and Japanese
Nine existing three-view toolbar cases at 360/600/1000 DIP widths
1x/2x dimensions and footer ink for 2D and Solid Model
tests.reentryCheck: Final targeted repeat of pending-dialog test passed; ignored duplicate triggers preserve the first export busy state. Not added to distinct count.

priorStages.cause: Fixture checked IsEnabled on StyledElement instead of Control
priorStages.resolution: Assert the actual parent Control before testing its enabled state

priorStages.result: 14/15 image tests passed; long-legend color check failed
priorStages.cause: Test assumed raw CopyPixels BGRA channel order
priorStages.resolution: Decode actual PNG with Skia and compare typed RGBA color; final 15/15 passed

renderEvidence.dpi: 96 DIP and explicit 2x pixel density; live UI normally supplies TopLevel.RenderScaling
renderEvidence.qualification: Synthetic material fixture validates display/legend completeness only; 2x offscreen export is not native high-DPI interaction acceptance

limits: No full-suite, new optical accuracy or performance certification
No native save-dialog/high-DPI system acceptance (picker interactions exercised with a storage-provider test double)
No push or public installer/DMG update
